function registerSiteServiceWorker(swUrl, hooks?): Promise<void>;

Defined in: core/utils/service-worker.ts:123

Registers swUrl and reports lifecycle through hooks. No-ops when navigator.serviceWorker is unavailable. Local hosts get the existence/mime probe first; a bad probe unregisters rather than installing a dev-shell SW.
